Summary.en: Joins the date of a date field with the time of a time field into a single value.
Summary.de: Verbindet das Datum eines Datumsfelds mit der Uhrzeit eines Zeitfelds zu einem Wert.
Summary.it: Unisce la data di un campo data con l'ora di un campo ora in un unico valore.

Parameter.DateField: Optional CSS selector selecting the input that provides the date. Takes precedence over the CodBi_Date_Time_Join_Date CSS class.
Parameter.TimeField: Optional CSS selector selecting the input that provides the time. Takes precedence over the CodBi_Date_Time_Join_Time CSS class.
Parameter.ToMillis: Whether the tagged input receives the combined date's getTime() milliseconds instead of its string representation (defaults to false).
Parameter.Divisor: Optional number that the combined date's milliseconds are divided by (floored) before writing them into the tagged input. Takes precedence over ToMillis.

DateField.default: Optional CSS selector selecting the input that provides the date. Takes precedence over the CodBi_Date_Time_Join_Date CSS class.

TimeField.default: Optional CSS selector selecting the input that provides the time. Takes precedence over the CodBi_Date_Time_Join_Time CSS class.

Divisor.default: Optional number that the combined date's milliseconds are divided by (floored) before writing them into the tagged input. Takes precedence over ToMillis.
